subject: AWS listing: clarification on brand claims & evidence handover
messages:
From: Maya Raj <mraj@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS listing flagged — branding/claims question

Hi Sergio / Laura,

AWS sent back a note this morning saying a line in our listing copy appears to imply a compliance certification: "enterprise-grade encryption and SOC2-equivalent controls". Their compliance reviewer is asking for evidence or removal.

Acme is pushing to keep the claim (they say it’s important for procurement). Can you confirm what evidence we can surface quickly? I can also ask Acme for their procurement template if useful.

Quick context: Acme's legal reviewed our security page and referenced the managed key options; they interpreted that as "enterprise-grade encryption" but AWS wants explicit supporting docs (SOC2 report or a controls matrix) or the phrasing softened.

Can someone from listings/legal/engineering confirm what we can share today? Acme is on a demo on Thursday and this is becoming a gating item.

Thanks,
Maya

--
Maya Raj
Head of Platform Procurement
Acme Analytics

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: AWS Marketplace Compliance <aws-mktplace-compliance@amazon.com>, aws-partner-team@amazon.com
Cc: Maya Raj <mraj@acmeanalytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing flagged — branding/claims question

Hi team,

Thanks for the flag — copying our legal and product ops to confirm required evidence. Short answers to the immediate options:

- If AWS requires a SOC2 report: we can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II summary (we have one from 2025) and a short controls mapping for marketplace reviewers.
- If AWS is OK with controls-level claims: we can provide a one-page controls matrix that maps the phrase "enterprise-grade encryption" to specific controls (KMS, in-transit TLS, disk encryption, key rotation).
- If neither is acceptable, we will revise the listing copy to a softer, verifiable wording (suggested alternate: "encryption-in-transit and at-rest with KMS-managed keys").

Action items we propose:
1) Laura: please confirm whether we can share the redacted SOC2 summary and the controls matrix to AWS (I think yes, but want sign-off).
2) Karthik / Marissa: please prepare the controls matrix + a short note on support windows (Acme asked about 24/7 vs business hours support in the listing notes).
3) Vanessa: I will need you to coordinate the DocuSign NDA if AWS asks for a reviewer NDA.

Maya — we want to avoid blocking your Thursday demo. If you can live with the softer phrasing for the listing this week, we can escalate the SOC2 paperwork in parallel and revert when cleared.

Sergio
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: AWS Marketplace Compliance <aws-mktplace-compliance@amazon.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, aws-partner-team@amazon.com
Cc: Maya Raj <mraj@acmeanalytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing flagged — branding/claims question

On Mon, 07 Dec 2026 at 11:05, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the flag — copying our legal and product ops to confirm required evidence.

Hello Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick reply. For marketplace policy we need one of the following to keep the current claim language:

1) A publicly-posted SOC2 Type II report or a published compliance summary with auditor contact, OR
2) A controls matrix tied to named controls (e.g., "KMS with AES-256, key rotation monthly, TLS1.2+ in transit") plus a letter from your security officer attesting accuracy; OR
3) Updated listing copy that removes or re-frames the certification-like language.

If you provide option 2, we will still need a verification step: either a signed attestation or a short reviewer NDA so our compliance team can see more detailed evidence. Attestation can be a one-paragraph statement on company letterhead signed by your Head of Security.

Regarding support windows: marketplace listings need clarity if you claim "24/7 support" versus "business-hours support with on-call escalation". If you claim 24/7 we expect a documented on-call rota and escalation SLA. If you claim business-hours, please specify timezone and hours.

We can accept a redacted SOC2 summary as part of option 1. Please let us know which option you'll pursue; if option 2, upload evidence to this secure reviewer link (we will send a per-thread reviewer link or require NDA).

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Compliance

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing flagged — branding/claims question

Team — quick internal summary and plan before I respond to AWS:

1) We will go with option 2 (controls matrix + attestation). Legal confirms we can provide a one-paragraph attestation signed by our Head of Security and a redacted controls matrix; we should avoid publishing the full SOC2 in the listing.

2) Karthik/Marissa: please draft the controls matrix covering encryption (KMS, TLS, disk encryption), key management, and retention. Target: first draft by EOD tomorrow. Add a short section that maps "enterprise-grade encryption" phrase to the specific controls so AWS has a line-by-line reference.

3) Support window: we will amend the listing to say "Business-hours support (PST 9am–5pm) with on-call escalation for critical incidents" unless Acme insists on 24/7. Marissa, confirm runbook link and on-call rota snippet to include.

4) Vanessa: be ready to send the NDA template if AWS requests it; Laura will sign the attestation.

I will coordinate the outgoing message to AWS and copy Sergio + Maya. Keep the evidence attachments in the thread DRIVE folder (see link).

Laura Bennett
Head, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Forwarded attachments: support-window-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
